events.title: The fall of Robespierre and the end of the Terror
events.shortBlurb: The execution of Robespierre brought the Reign of Terror to a close and eased the persecution of the Church…
body: Maximilien Robespierre, the dominant figure of the Committee of Public Safety, had presided over the Reign of Terror in which thousands were sent to the guillotine, among them many priests, religious, and faithful who would not submit to the revolutionary church. Turned upon by his own colleagues in the Convention, he was arrested and, on the twenty-eighth of July 1794, guillotined.

His death broke the machinery of the Terror and brought its executions to an end. For the Church in France, savagely persecuted in those years, it opened the way to a gradual respite from the worst of the bloodshed.
